title: Mountain Pass
text: Well, now that Yuki-chan and the others have finished transforming, I’ll pay the innkeeper a little extra and take them up to a room. It’ll cost a bit, but I just can’t bring myself to let them sleep in the stable.
“You understand, right?”
“Of course.”
“Yeah!”

We’ll pretend to be asleep and activate the portal the same way. I’ve done this a few times with Yuki and the others, so they already get it. Then we got into bed and fidgeted around, pretending to be asleep. After a little while, we got out of bed.
“Ugh…”
“Seriously, Kou… Come on, wake up.”

Yuki-chan shook Kou awake, looking exasperated. After setting things up to make it look like we were still sleeping in bed, I used the portal to teleport to Siltvelt. In an instant, my view shifted to the town below Siltvelt Castle.

Siltvelt is a country of Demi-Humans, and quite a few of them are nocturnal. Therefore, there are surprisingly few shops that close at night, unlike in Melromarc. Of course, there are probably some shops that are only open during the day, but they’re fewer compared to Melromarc. I looked for a clothing store in Siltvelt and went into one that had equipment to convert Magical Power into thread.
“I’d like you to turn these kids’ Magical Power into thread.”
“Uh, uh-huh…”
“We’d appreciate your help.”
“Sure thing!”

The Demi-Human gave me a puzzled look when they saw me, a human, bringing Yuki-chan and the others, but upon seeing how lively they were, they agreed to help. When Bofun and Filolial-sama transformed, the clerk seemed a bit surprised, but it wasn’t a problem.

As expected of the real deal, turning their Magical Power into thread was quite affordable. Now all that’s left is to turn this into fabric. I’m not talking about my Father here, but I should find a buyer to raise some travel funds.
…Come to think of it, couldn’t I raise some money by pretending to be an ordinary adventurer at the Siltvelt Adventurers’ Guild? That’s right. It wouldn’t hurt to do that while I’m at it.

But for now, getting clothes for Yuki-chan and the others is the top priority. As soon as I get the thread, I’ll have it run through the machine to turn it into fabric. It won’t take that long, but since we’ll be making the clothes from scratch, it’ll probably be morning by the time we’re done…

Well, we have plenty of time. I’ve been thinking of a plan while traveling as a peddler, so I’ll probably tackle that then. Right after getting the fabric, we headed back to the inn in the village of Melromarc.
“Ugh… Kou, I’m so sleepy—”
“Go ahead and sleep as long as you like.”
“Aren’t you going to sleep, Motoyasu-sama? Yawn…”
“I’ll sleep. But before that, I’d like to get Yuki-chan and the others’ clothes ready up to the basting stage.”
“Then can I watch?”
“Sure.”
As I carefully sewed Yuki-chan and the others’ clothes, Yuki-chan and Kou began to breathe quietly in their sleep on the bed.
“Mmm…”

I’m a bit tired from hunting day after day. Sewing clothes is a task I’m used to, but I think I’ll call it a night after a while. I’ll try the basted clothes on Yuki-chan and the others while they’re sleeping.
Hmm. They fit Yuki-chan and the others perfectly. I, Motoyasu, can gauge Filolial-sama’s size at a glance. With that thought in mind, I fell asleep in the same bed as Yuki-chan and the others.

That night, I had a delightful dream in which I was reunited with Filo-tan. My Father was also smiling kindly at me. For Filo-tan and my Father, I’d go through fire and water—anywhere at all. I felt a slight disconnect from reality, but it was a very pleasant dream.

The next day. I don’t have any plans to meet my Father today. But come to think of it, this is the day Sakura-chan is set to become an angel… . Will everything be all right? Well, knowing my Father and the others, I don’t think there’ll be any problems.
“Lord Motoyasu, what shall we do today?”

We’ve been hunting at night, but… this kind of underhanded approach is a bit stressful. It’s because we can’t afford to do anything that would forcefully reveal just how strong our side really is. I’m starting to get really fed up and just want to go ahead and kill that Trash, that Crimson Swine, and the Pope. Assassinating them like that Smoked Meat would be a good tactic, but doing so would create differences from the original world in various ways. …What am I supposed to do about this stress?
“We’re going to do a ‘toge’.”
“What’s a ‘Kitamura Toge’?”
“Do you mean a downhill mountain road?”
Kou is tilting his head. Yuki-chan looks just as confused. In terms of meaning, Yuki-chan’s interpretation is correct. However, the “toge” I’m referring to has a different meaning.
“‘Toge’ refers to when the Filolial-sama race down mountain roads.”
“Wow… Can we really go all out!?”
“Of course.”
Kou’s eyes light up. Yuki-chan is fidgeting, though she’s acting as if she finds it unladylike to prioritize such things. After all, the Filolial-sama generally love to run.
It’s a great way to relieve stress. Above all, exercising helps maintain a healthy body. As for me, just riding on Filolial-sama’s back over a mountain pass is enough to blow all my stress away.
“If we’re lucky, we might even run into some bandits. If we take them down and snag a carriage from their hideout, that’d be killing two birds with one stone.”
“Are bandits tasty?”
“You mustn’t eat them.”

Father said so. Personally, I think it’d be fine to at least give criminals a bird burial. Well, personally, I don’t want Filolial-sama to eat anything weird, so I wouldn’t feed her bandits or anything like that.
“Kou… Keel-kun’s tail was wagging right in front of me, and it looked so delicious.”
Kou murmurs with a blissful expression. Hmm… Is she interested in that dog’s tail? Come to think of it, Filo-tan used to follow her Big Sister’s tail with her eyes quite often, too.

When my Father wasn’t around, she asked, “I’ve been thinking this for a while, but Raphtalia-onee-chan’s tail is round and looks delicious, doesn’t it? Can I eat it?” Her Big Sister, smiling but with an intimidating air, replied, “You can eat it, but in exchange, I’ll have Naofumi-sama cook up Filo’s wings.” Filo-tan let out a cry of “Nooo!” My Finacée watched that exchange with a look of exasperation.
“If you do something like that, your Father will definitely get mad at you.”
“Oh, really… That’s too bad.”
“Today, I’m going to let my hair down!”
“Yay!”

It’s not exactly a search for Filo-tan… but now that I’ve got my clothes ready, there’s almost nothing left for me to do. The only thing left is to procure some of those seeds that might be useful for peddling.

The next morning. After crossing the mountain pass and clearing the dungeon where those seeds were found, I headed straight to my Father’s place. He was staying at an inn in Riyute Village. As I was walking around Riyute Village looking for him, he called out to me from the inn window.
“Hey, Motoyasu! Perfect timing! Come over here.”
Following Father’s instructions, I went into the inn and made my way to his room.
“Yesterday, I did all sorts of things with Keel and Sakura—like gathering medicinal herbs and slaying monsters around here—but… I thought Sakura might feel left out, so I was resting in the barn.”
I can’t quite make head or tail of what Father is saying.
“Boo-boo!”
As for Keel, he’s still speaking Pig-speak, so I can’t understand a word he’s saying.
“Then…”
“She turned into an angel, didn’t she!”
“Well, that’s how it turned out! Wait—is that Yuki-chan standing behind Motoyasu-kun!? I’d heard about her… but she’s so young.”
“Young, you say?”

Yuki-chan and the others are almost the same height as Filo-tan. Well, most of the Filolial-samas I know are about this tall when they’re in angel form. But judging by the way Father put it, was Sakura-chan different?
“Sakura-chan! Come here.”
“Hmm? What’s up?”

I turned my gaze toward the direction Sakura-chan’s voice was coming from. There, standing in that direction, was an angel with cherry-blossom-colored hair, around 17 years old, with wings sprouting from her back… and a slightly gentle-looking face.
